# SkipLink

A link to the page's main content, invisible until it takes keyboard focus and then fixed at the inline-start top corner on a surface, drawing the shared focus ring (D88). Render it first in the document. No script: native fragment navigation moves focus to a target that is focusable, so the next *Tab* continues from inside it. `AppShell`'s `main` is one (`tabIndex={-1}`); a bare `<main>` is not, so give it one. A modal `Dialog` makes the rest of the document inert, so the link never needs to beat one. A `ToastRegion` is on the native top layer, which paints above everything whatever its `z-index`: do not place one at `top-start` (its default is `bottom-end`) in an app with a skip link, or it covers the focused link.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `href` | `string` | — | yes | Fragment of the element to skip to, such as `"#main"`. The target must be focusable (`tabIndex={-1}` is enough), or focus does not move. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | yes | Visible text, such as "Skip to content". |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLAnchorElement>` | — | no | Forwarded ref to the anchor. |
| `className` | `string` | — | no | Additional CSS class name(s) merged onto the component's root element. |

## Keyboard & assistive tech

| Keys | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Tab | Takes focus and becomes visible at the inline-start top corner, drawing the shared focus ring. Put it first in the document so it is the first tab stop. |
| Enter | Follows the fragment href: focus moves to the target, and the next Tab continues from inside it. |

A native anchor, visually hidden until it is focused (:focus-visible) and with no script (D88). Fragment navigation moves focus only to a focusable target, so the element named by href must be focusable: tabIndex={-1} is enough, and AppShell's main has it. A modal Dialog makes the link inert, so it never needs to beat one. A ToastRegion is on the native top layer and paints over the focused link whatever its z-index: do not place one at top-start in an app with a skip link.

## Theming

Override `--psi-skip-link-*` custom properties at any scope.



## Rules

- One accent per visual group; everything else neutral or ghost.
- danger only for actions with real consequences.
- Sizes are px numbers (24|32|40|48), never S/M/L.
- Typography tokens are --psi-text-{size}-{lineHeight}-{weight}.
- Override component tokens (--psi-{component}-*), not semantic tokens, for one-off theming.
- --psi-button-font overrides button typography across all sizes (documented D34 override; ember → mono).
- Wrap labeled form controls in Field — label association, description/error line, aria-describedby and aria-invalid come wired; don't hand-roll label+message rows.
- Field is for a control with a *visible* label. A toolbar filter control named by aria-label or placeholder takes neither a Field nor a hand-rolled label row — compare filter-toolbar (no labels) with table-pagination ("Rows per page" visible, so Field). Filters with visible labels submitted together by a Find button are filter-form: a Toolbar as="form" align="start" of Fields with one-line labels, where a field's error line is the Field's own and hangs below its control (D87, D92).
- Label beside its control: <Field labelPosition="start"> for one field in a toolbar or pager (keep Toolbar align="center"); <FieldStack labelPosition="start"> for a form whose labels share one column, as wide as the longest label up to --psi-field-label-max-width, stacking below 480px of the form's width. A theme sets --psi-field-label-align: end to put labels against their controls (D115).
- Width of a control: <Field controlWidth={80|120|160|240|320|480}> sizes the control it wraps in px and lets it shrink in a narrower column; the label and message keep the Field's width. Pick the step from the value: at size 32 an Input fits about 7/12/17/26/36/55 digits (an ICCID's 20 digits → 240; a page-size Select → 80). Without it the control fills the Field. A FieldStack stops at --psi-field-stack-max-width (640px). In a Toolbar, the control of a top-labelled Field without controlWidth takes --psi-toolbar-control-width (200px), as a bare control does, so filter-form and date-range-filter rows are even; controlWidth replaces it, and a side-labelled Field (Rows per page) keeps its content width (D135).
- A popup's maximum height is --psi-popup-max-height (320px), shared by every popup through its own alias (--psi-menu-max-height, --psi-combobox-popup-max-height); past it the popup scrolls. Override the alias for one component, the shared token for all (D131).
- Select for a short fixed list; Combobox when the list is long enough to search, or more than one value is picked (D130). Combobox takes options as data ({value, label, description?, disabled?}), filters as the user types, and with multiple shows the picked values as Tags. Select has no multiple.
- Use Dialog for blocking modal flows — title/footer slots, dismissible gate; danger stays on the footer Buttons, one accent per group.
- Text links are Link (React) or the .psi-link class on any <a>: accent colour, underlined at rest, never by colour alone (D119). A router app passes its own link as Link's only child. Button href is for an action that should look like a button. Inside a NavItem or among NavBar's links, pass your router link itself, not Link.
- Pick between Tabs, SegmentedControl and RadioGroup by the job (D132). Switch 2–4 views of one region compactly (Map/Trace, Preview/Code): <Tabs> with a <SegmentedControl aria-label> (no value: Tabs owns it) of <Segment>s in place of TabList, outside the TabPanels, plus a TabPanel per segment. Switch page sections, more than 4 views, or a vertical list: Tabs + TabList + Tab. Pick one of 2–4 short options that applies at once (Light/Dark/System, a theme): <SegmentedControl aria-label value onValueChange>, a radio group wherever it sits (value makes it one). A value a form submits, options with descriptions, or more than 4: RadioGroup (Select for many). An action: Button or Toolbar. Segment labels are one or two words; the control never wraps, and truncates them when its container is narrower; fill shares the width equally. Sizes 24|32|40.
- A count after a label is Count (D124): neutral by default; tone="attention" is a pill and should carry a label ("4 stuck"), since the tone is visual. A Count is never a live region. In a NavTree, pass it as NavItem's count, and an icon as icon on NavItem or NavGroup; the icon is decorative and sized by the tree.
